title: MILES-Rec: Uncovering Implicit Intents from Mobility Behaviors for Cross-Domain POI Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2610.41319v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Map applications bridge everyday mobility with local services, creating opportunities to recommend places by uncovering users' implicit intents. However, utility-driven map interactions provide only indirect and incomplete evidence of consumption demands, making it challenging to infer personalized service needs from observed behaviors. We propose MILES-Rec, a cross-domain POI recommendation framework that infers latent service intents from heterogeneous map behaviors and expresses them as prioritized natural language queries. It first learns from progressive reasoning demonstrations that synthesize user profiles and map histories for situation understanding, intent expansion, and query prioritization. We then introduce intent-aligned group relative policy optimization, using subsequent user interactions to reward query relevance and ranked service coverage while penalizing redundancy and excessive response length. translated_title: MILES-Rec：从出行行为中挖掘隐式意图以实现跨领域POI推荐
translated_abstract: 地图应用将日常出行与本地服务连接起来，为通过挖掘用户隐式意图来推荐地点创造了机会。然而，由效用驱动的地图交互只能提供关于消费需求的间接且不完整的证据，这使得从观察到的行为中推断个性化服务需求变得极具挑战性。我们提出了MILES-Rec，这是一个跨领域兴趣点（POI）推荐框架，它从异构的地图行为中推断潜在的服务意图，并将其表达为按优先级排序的自然语言查询。该框架首先从渐进式推理示范中学习，这些示范综合了用户画像和地图历史，用于情境理解、意图扩展和查询优先级排序。随后，我们引入了意图对齐的组相对策略优化，利用用户后续的交互来奖励查询相关性和排序后的服务覆盖率，同时惩罚冗余和过长的响应长度，并采用两级信用分配机制……
tldr: 该论文提出MILES-Rec跨领域POI推荐框架，通过从异构地图行为中推断用户潜在服务意图并将其表达为按优先级排序的自然语言查询，并结合意图对齐的组相对策略优化，实现了对用户个性化服务需求的精准挖掘与推荐。
